title: Board header variants
commands: yoke board art variant create --ascii|--mixed|--image PATH
summary: Board art is optional customization after project installation. Choose --ascii, --mixed or --image with a PNG/JPEG path; the command previews a variant and offers append or reroll. --apply appends the first generated variant without prompting. It does not establish project readiness.
recipes: yoke board art variant create --image ./logo.png --display-name "Example App"
verification: Source help inspected; no variant was generated or applied, and no receiving-context behavior is verified here.
